integrity: The theorem concerns only the ordinary convex-transform and all-level expectile-transform orders. The discrete skeleton is supplemented by an explicit continuous full-support construction and a rigorous perturbation bound. Priority remains subject to independent bibliographic review.
scientific_limitations: The explicit mixture has a positive, bounded, piecewise constant density on its interval; the theorem asserts a counterexample, not a general classification or any result for smooth, log-concave, or unbounded-support densities.
title: A continuous convex-transform counterexample for expectile coordinates
